package rulefixtures

import (
	"context"
	"database/sql"
)

// scenario for n_plus_one_query: Database-style query calls issued inside loops. The semantic pack can raise severity when nested loops also appear.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: contextual.
type Rule620PositiveRecord struct {
	ID   int
	Name string
}

func scenario620Positive(ctx context.Context, db *sql.DB, parentIDs []int) ([]Rule620PositiveRecord, error) {
	var results []Rule620PositiveRecord
	for _, parentID := range parentIDs {
		rows, err := db.QueryContext(ctx, "SELECT id, name FROM children WHERE parent_id = ?", parentID)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		for rows.Next() {
			var rec Rule620PositiveRecord
			if err := rows.Scan(&rec.ID, &rec.Name); err != nil {
				rows.Close()
				return nil, err
			}
			results = append(results, rec)
		}
		rows.Close()
	}
	return results, nil
}
